material_omissions: No independent evaluation, causal analysis, or counterfactual evidence was supplied.

notes: All propositions are unreviewed model candidates based only on the supplied frozen corpus.

Named reserves, programs, partners, and landscapes are unresolved candidates rather than durable entities.
